items.title: Meta launches Muse Spark Open, an 816B-parameter open-weight model
items.summary: Meta released Muse Spark Open, a natively multimodal open-weight model with a 1M-token context window, pitched at coding and agentic work. Running it locally needs about 1 TB of RAM (Mac Studio M5 Ultra), and it is also offered through several API platforms.
items.whyItMatters: Too large to self-host for a voice tutor and no voice or French support was mentioned, but it is another open-weight option that could pressure LLM pricing for the text-reasoning layer.

items.title: Anthropic gives METR researchers employee-level access to audit its models
items.summary: Six METR researchers get employee-level access to independently assess Anthropic's models, safety practices and risk management, and can publish findings without a corporate veto. The arrangement is modeled on embedded bank examiners.
items.whyItMatters: Worth knowing as a sign of how frontier labs are handling third-party scrutiny; the link to the tutor is indirect.
